items.title: Guaranteed IPO allotment
items.claim: “Pay a fee and your allotment is guaranteed.”
items.reality: Allotment follows the published process; no unauthorised person can guarantee it.
items.action: Do not pay the sender. Verify your application through official channels.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional

items.title: Discounted IPO shares through a private app
items.claim: “Get IPO shares below issue price through our special app.”
items.reality: A private app or message is not an official IPO application route.
items.action: Do not install unknown apps or transfer money to third parties.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional

items.title: Fake institutional / anchor account access
items.claim: “Retail users can access a secret institutional IPO account.”
items.reality: Eligibility and allocation categories are governed by rules and offer documents; a message cannot grant a category.
items.action: Verify category details in the RHP and official regulatory sources.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional

items.title: WhatsApp / Telegram sure-shot tips
items.claim: “Join our VIP group for guaranteed listing gains.”
items.reality: A guarantee is not evidence. Check registration; a chat group is not an official disclosure source.
items.action: Do not send money or credentials. Verify with SEBI.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional

items.title: Fake allotment link / UPI mandate
items.claim: “Approve this UPI request or pay to release your allotment.”
items.reality: Use the official bank / broker / registrar process. Do not approve unknown collect requests or share PIN/OTP.
items.action: Stop and verify directly through your bank app and official intermediary.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional

items.title: Fake GMP screenshot
items.claim: “This screenshot proves a guaranteed listing premium.”
items.reality: GMP is unofficial; sources can differ and timestamps matter.
items.action: Do not treat it as an exchange price or prediction.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional

items.title: Pressure and FOMO
items.claim: “Last five minutes — transfer now or lose guaranteed profits.”
items.reality: Pressure does not create a legitimate route or guarantee returns.
items.action: Pause and verify issue details on official pages.
items.scenario_type: Investor-protection learning pattern; practice version is fictional
